title: BFA环球研究：AI行情扩散，香港市场情绪修复
speaker: Winnie Wu

segments.en: Yeah. I think the sentiment is certainly shifting a little bit.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为市场情绪确实在发生一些变化。

segments.en: In May early June, what we saw is extreme concentration in terms of investors' focus, in terms of the sector positioning.
segments.zh: 五月初到六月初，我们看到投资者关注度和板块配置都极度集中。

segments.en: And that's when we saw the press of the Hong Kong market was nearly a 10-year low. Only 10% of the Hong Kong stocks were trading above the 200-day average.
segments.zh: 当时香港市场的估值压力接近十年低位，只有10%的个股在200日均线之上。

segments.en: And that's usually sign of market botany. Since then, in July, we see some improvement in terms of the market press.
segments.zh: 这通常是市场见底的信号。自那以后，7月份市场压力有所缓解。

segments.en: I think, you know, currently, a lot of investor view is that the AI rally is not over. AI is structural. And there is real earnings contribution.
segments.zh: 目前很多投资者认为AI行情尚未结束，AI是结构性趋势，且有真实的盈利贡献。

segments.en: Nonetheless, you know, the extreme concentration in the upstream, in the semi-stocks, in the memory stocks is probably broadening out. And people look at cloud, for example, as one area where we see good revenue growth.
segments.zh: 不过，上游、半导体和存储板块的极度集中可能正在扩散。比如云服务领域，我们看到不错的收入增长。

segments.en: And this monetization is a big concern for Chinese internet platforms, in particular, is that can you monetize on the two C and, you know, the more success you become in your LLM, the more costly it will become for your earnings, right? That's the concern.
segments.zh: 对于中国互联网平台来说，变现能力是个大问题——大模型越成功，对盈利的成本压力就越大，这正是市场的担忧。
